maps.points.abandoned_mines_cave.dialogu: Event opening (There are no thieves in the team)
Event opening (The enemy has not yet drank from the pool)
Deep in the cavern, you discover a small pool filled with an unnatural blue liquid. Its perfectly still surface reflects no light.
Drink from the pond.
"Let me check the substance..." (Party member required: Raven, Available once)
"Let me test how it feels." (Party member required: Slugman, Available once)
"Check for magical traces in the water." (Party member required: Wizard, Available once)
"Check for animal tracks." (Party member required: Ranger, Available once)
Event opening (Water from the pool already consumed)
The pool lies still and colorless. Whatever magic once lingered here has faded away. You see your reflection, nothing more.
Choose “Check for animal tracks.”
SNAP! A sharp snap echoes as the mechanism triggers.
You search the muddy ground around the pool.
No tracks.
"Nothing drinks from this."
Choose “Let me check the substance...”
You crouch beside the pool, studying its strange blue liquid. Something about it feels familiar.
You sense the unstable magic within the water. Whatever it does to living flesh, it may affect you differently.
"Mutation water. Unstable, yes. Dangerous to most, probably."
"But not to me."
Choose “Check for magical traces in the water.”
You focus on the still water, drawing small sparks between your fingers. The energy hums in response.
Something slams into the party, knocking you off balance.
"Old transmutation residue," you say. "Very unpredictable."
Choose “Let me test how it feels.”
You dip a finger into the pool. The blue liquid clings to your skin.
A low vibration runs through your body.
"Feels alive..." you whisper. "... and corrupted."
Choose “Drink from the pond.”
Who will drink from the pond?
Event opening (Party member required: Thief)
Your eyes catch a thin cord stretched low across the tunnel, nearly invisible in the dark.
"Tripwire. Be careful and do not step into it."
The trap has been disarmed.
The mechanism slams into the corpses. They stagger, but keep coming.
The trap hangs broken now, its force spent.
